integrity: The proof supplies the infinite-length arguments. Independent validation has not been performed; finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic path representation, two fixed-initial-law scaling regimes and uniform extreme-time enumeration; not a full finite-size distribution or a vanishing-third-color crossover. The path maximum principle and universal diameter bound are prior results. Historical-equivalence risk remains.
title: A support-sensitive synchronization law for three-color cyclic dynamics on paths
